_doc: Router Core Card B1 (t_4187c8f1) replay fixture: every worker_placed event on the live default board whose placement_reservation matches an admitted kanban row of var/placement/admissions.jsonl (the scorer path, t_d6ce856e), read-only on 2026-10-15. Per decision: the placement table in force (config/fleet-hosts.json at the hermes-home commit named, _-keys and router stripped), the per-host rows the scorer logged (load, MemAvailable, live reservations, eligibility + reason), the Job inputs (assignee, card priority, previous placed host) and the old path's decision {host, rule}. Built by a one-off script; not regenerated in CI.
